_comment: Optional bounds for what the PI may choose when it staffs a job (--pi). Copy to policy.json to activate. Enforced: max_workers (clamps the PI's WORKERS: request), effort_max (caps the effort it may put a role on), backends_allowed (restricts which backends it may put a role on; a dropped backend takes its model with it). Every clamp is recorded in the job's log.jsonl. budget_tokens_max is reserved. These bound the PI only -- your own --role/--effort flags are never clamped.
